newsitem.title: USA: Montana Power names Gannon chairman, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Montana Power names Gannon chairman, CEO.

text.p: Montana Power Co announced Tuesday plans for Robert Gannon to succeed Daniel Berube as its chairman of the board and chief executive officer later next year.
Berube said he plans to retire at the end of 1997, less than a year before his required retirement.
Montana Power's board said Gannon will become CEO on July 1, 1997, and chairman at the end of 1997.

Gannon was appointed president of the Butte-based utility in 1990 and became vice-chairman of the board in January of this year with the primary responsibility of directing the company's restructuring.
